decision.detail: I walk to the bench in the Greyhound waiting area. I sit. I put my bag on the ground beside me. I press my spine flat against the backrest. I close my eyes. I do not go to the payphone again. I do not go to the ballroom. I do not go to the Rialto. I sit.
decision.intention: Let my body be tired. Let the evening be short. Let me be here, on this bench, in this city, with the couch a couch and my sister a sister and the van a van and the gloves in my bag. That is enough for tonight. That is the whole forecast.
decision.words: *silence* — *one slow breath in, one slow breath out, eyes shut before the bench even creaks*
